citations.excerpt: He married Anne, and was baptized on the day of his wedding, a.d. 988.

facts.value: Grand Duke Vladimir of Kiev was baptized and established Christianity as the religion of his realm.

citations.excerpt: The progress of Christianity among the Russians was slow until the grand-duke Vladimir (980–1015), a grandson of Olga, and revered as Isapostolos (“Equal to an Apostle”) with one sweep established it as the religion of the country.
